summary.title: High Performance Computing Tuning Guide for AMD EPYC 9004 Series Processors (58002)
summary.one_liner: AMD's HPC tuning guide for EPYC 9004 processors, which tabulates measured memory bandwidth by NPS mode, cores per die, boost and SMT settings.

how to tune epyc for hpc workloads
takeaways: AMD's document 58002 (revision 1.0, dated 2024-07-08) is a tuning guide for EPYC 9004 Series processors aimed at HPC.
The guide tabulates measured bandwidth across NPS modes, cores per die, boost and SMT settings.
The page text provided is mostly cookie banner content; the tuning tables themselves were not visible in the captured text.
summary.summary: This is AMD document 58002, revision 1.0 dated 2024-07-08, a High Performance Computing tuning guide for EPYC 9004 Series processors. According to the listing, it tabulates measured bandwidth by NPS mode, cores per die, boost and SMT settings so the NPS trade-off is shown with data. The captured page text contains almost only cookie-consent boilerplate and the document title and metadata, so the specific measurements and recommendations could not be read from this copy. The entry is best treated as a pointer to the PDF-style reference for NUMA and BIOS tuning decisions on EPYC 9004 systems.
